protocol.purpose: Paired post-training comparison for deficient in-place yaw tracking; all three prior training seeds retained.
protocol.source_selection: All three seeds of the previous 32-environment study, whose yaw tracking deficiency was already observed. Not fresh independent pretraining replicates.

variants.turn_commands: Use existing mode RNG draw: 2% standing, 20% pure yaw sampled uniformly from [-1,1], 78% original forward+yaw commands. Reward unchanged.
variants.turn_commands_air: Same command mixture; enable air-time reward when planar speed norm >0.1 m/s OR absolute yaw command >0.1 rad/s.

protocol.continuation_seed: Same as source training seed in every variant.
protocol.candidate_screen: At least 20% lower mean in-place yaw RMSE over six seed/direction cells than original, no lower in-place survival count; no lower survival count over all 18 cells; forward and standing mean planar RMSE each no more than 0.05 m/s worse. This is a local screening criterion, not deployment acceptance or statistical significance.
protocol.budget_rule: Complete every 2500-update training job; do not stop early or select checkpoints using evaluation results.
limits: Nominal deterministic initial states only; evaluation seeds do not create independent reset samples.
No extra reward-only arm: the incremental air-time comparison is conditional on changed command sampling.
Only three existing training chains; no universal or real-robot claim.
Resume restores policy and Adam, resets environment and RNG.
Experiment variants are frozen local sources, not exposed product options.

randomized_protocol.purpose: Secondary characterization under training reset randomization, declared before viewing randomized results. This does not change the nominal screening criterion.
limits: Each batch samples 32 independent initial rows from the training reset distribution; commands reuse the same batch to allow paired comparisons.
No observation noise, mid-episode perturbation, terrain change, or physical robot test.
64 initial rows per model/command do not represent 64 independently trained models.
RMSE pools observed frames and can decrease when poor trials fall early; survival and duration must be examined together.

followup_protocol.purpose: Verify full training parity after the evaluation-only change and add one fresh-training budget reference.
followup_protocol.fresh_reference_limits: Seed 1234 selected because its previously observed small-batch policy was poor. One fresh run cannot establish that scratch training is generally better than continuation. Total transitions equal the selected pretraining-plus-continuation chain, but PPO update counts, batching, and reset history differ.

limits: Post-hoc mechanistic study, distinct from the initial three-arm experiment.
Three existing pretraining chains, not new independent training seeds.
